digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: The dual 'Success Criteria' / 'Acceptance Criteria' vocabulary is pooled into one bar across plan-review criteria and should be collapsed to 'Acceptance Criteria' at the source.
Rename Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria across the listed reviewer prompts and the criteria routing index, then regenerate the generated criteria guide.
G3's two bare 'SC' tokens must be edited by hand rather than by pattern because \bSC\b also matches unrelated tokens like O-RAN-SC.
plan_review_T2.md and the dod_uncertifiable wording in the verifier prompts are deliberately excluded because their meaning differs from the ticket heading.
Editing criteria_routing.json rotates the regver registry stamp, invalidating outstanding plan-review attestations, which is safe only after the grandfathering prerequisite ticket has merged.
A test must prove registry_version rotates by capturing pre-edit and post-edit values at run time rather than hard-coding either.
